name: Securo
short_desc: Self-hosted personal finance manager: accounts, budgets, bank sync.
author: securo-finance
description: Securo is an open-source personal finance manager that runs on your own infrastructure. Multi-account tracking, transactions, budgets, goals, recurring operations, OFX/QIF/CSV import, Enable Banking sync for European banks, multi-currency and optional OIDC login.
